items.source: Includes the given fields into the projection.
items.translation: 将指定字段包含到投影中。

items.source: Creates a new ProjectionOperation including all top level fields of the given given Class.
items.translation: 创建一个包含给定Class所有顶级字段的新的ProjectionOperation。

items.source: Creates a new ProjectionOperation including the given Fields.
items.translation: 创建一个包含给定Fields的新ProjectionOperation。

items.source: Creates a new ProjectionOperation.ExpressionProjectionOperationBuilder for the given value, ProjectionOperation and parameters.
items.translation: 为给定的值、ProjectionOperation 和参数创建一个新的 ProjectionOperation.ExpressionProjectionOperationBuilder。

items.source: Creates a new ProjectionOperation.ProjectionOperationBuilder for the field with the given value on top of the given ProjectionOperation.
items.translation: 为给定值上的字段创建一个新的 ProjectionOperation.ProjectionOperationBuilder，该操作基于给定的 ProjectionOperation。

items.source: Creates a new ProjectionOperation.ProjectionOperationBuilder for the field with the given name on top of the given ProjectionOperation.
items.translation: 为给定名称的字段在指定的 ProjectionOperation 之上创建一个新的 ProjectionOperation.ProjectionOperationBuilder。

items.source: Create the ProjectionOperation for the array property with given name.
items.translation: 为具有给定名称的数组属性创建ProjectionOperation。

items.source: Includes the current ProjectionOperation as an array with given name.
items.translation: 包含当前带有指定名称的ProjectionOperation数组。

items.source: Creates a new ProjectionOperation including the given fields.
items.translation: 创建一个包含给定字段的新的ProjectionOperation。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Excludes the given fields from the projection.
items.translation: 从投影中排除给定字段。

items.source: Allows to specify an alias for the previous projection operation.
items.translation: 允许为前一个投影操作指定别名。

items.source: Defines a nested field binding for the current field.
items.translation: 为当前字段定义嵌套字段绑定。

items.source: Projects the result of the previous operation onto the current field.
items.translation: 将上一操作的结果投影到当前字段。

items.source: Uses of ProjectionOperation in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: ProjectionOperation 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
